title: Grateful Dead Live at Legion Stadium on 1970-12-28

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a smooth Dec 28 1970 show featuring the rare Cryptical > Other One > Cryptical sequence, a smoky Smokestack Lightning opener and a big Good Lovin' closer.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises this third night of the California run as the smoothest of the three, highlighting the unusual Cryptical‑Other One‑Cryptical sandwich, the second‑set opener Smokestack Lightning and an uplifting Good Lovin' finale. No specific audio flaws are noted, suggesting a decent soundboard capture, while the performance is described as reaching “optimal overdrive.”

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review emphasizes strong musical moments and gives no complaints about sound, leading to a solid but not outstanding rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on clarity or mix; presumed typical soundboard quality without noticeable issues.

standout_songs: Cryptical Envelopment > The Other One > Cryptical Envelopment
show_quality.setlist_flow: The second set is described as smooth and energetic, with a strong opener and a big closer, indicating good pacing throughout the night.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's spoken intro before Smokestack Lightning is quoted, reflecting his keyboard/vocal presence.
